dispositions.reason: THE CONFIDENTIALITY LEGEND, and A TRAP: it READS LIKE A PROHIBITION ('is not for use or disclosure outside of AT&T ... except under written agreement'). Excluded on TWO independent grounds, either sufficient -- its subject is 'This Agreement and information contained therein', a THING, and 'is not for use or disclosure' is copular status -- AND it is furniture, recurring in 35 of C03's 204 pool segments, i.e. a legend stamped on every page rather than a clause of the agreement.
dispositions.span_text: Proprietary and Confidential This Agreement and information contained therein is not for use or disclosure outside of AT&T, its Affiliates, and third party representatives, and Vendor except under written agreement by the contracting parties.

dispositions.reason: Page number 43 fused with the EDGAR source stamp 'Source: ATN INTERNATIONAL, INC., 10-Q, 11/8/2019', which recurs in 35 of C03's 204 pool segments. No modal, no subject, no predicate.

The REAL section heading, '3.42 Transaction Costs.' -- fused into the furniture fragment by the splitter rather than standing alone, which is why this segment is dispositioned at sub-sentence granularity.
